description: iFlytek Astron Token Plan - Configure Claude Code to use Spark-X2.5 through the Anthropic-compatible endpoint of iFlytek Astron MaaS (讯飞星辰 MaaS). Spark-X2.5 has a 256K context window on the Token Plan; other models on the plan (GLM, DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, MiniMax) can be selected by changing the model IDs. Requires a Token Plan API key from https://maas.xfyun.cn/tokenPlan/subscription
